# Cristian Correa

> Software engineer and statistician with deep roots in big data engineering. Based in Bogotá, Colombia.

Last updated: 2026-08-03

## Summary

Cristian Correa (sometimes "Cris Correa" or just "Cris") is a software engineer and statistician with deep roots in big data engineering. He likes building products, is comfortable working with large amounts of data for ML and AI, loves real-time products, and loves taking things from zero to one. Eight years in tech.

- **Name:** Cristian Correa
- **Role:** Software Engineer, Statistician
- **Location:** Bogotá, Colombia
- **Site:** https://cris.fast
- **Email:** cristian.correa.cs@gmail.com

- **Croma** (https://usecroma.com) — Founder, since June 2026. API for government data.

*2024, 7 months*
Data for cashback on premium products at LATAM's largest digital bank.

*May 2022 – Apr 2023*
Worked on dbt project structure and CI/CD, helped migrate the warehouse from Redshift to BigQuery, and built an offline feature store.

### Rappi — Data & Software Engineer
*May 2020 – May 2022*
Helped build the data foundation for Rappi Ads, including the keyword recommendation system for ads and the insights behind churn and revenue decisions.

### Azzorti — Data & Analytics, SAP BI
*Oct 2018 – Jun 2020*
SAP BW and HANA implementations, BusinessObjects reporting, and a PHP–R integration over SOAP.

### Taller de Carpintería — Carpenter
*Jan 2010 – Dec 2018*
Furniture and finishes at a local workshop in Bogotá. Started building things as a carpenter — same instinct, different material.
